name: Kids' Name Puzzle
description: A child's name as a puzzle: a tray with a pocket shaped like each letter, and a chunky letter piece for each pocket that stands proud of the tray so small fingers can grab it. The tray can be a rounded rectangle, a cloud, or a train with one wagon per letter. Letters cycle through four colours; the counters of A, B, O stay in the tray as islands. Tray and letters print flat on one plate with no supports.
source: inspired by MakerWorld Parametric Model Maker name/letter puzzles and Printables Letters Puzzle (#523629, 248 downloads) and Alphabet Puzzle (#643522, 180 downloads)
